subject: Clutch Health RFP: request for competitive offset + trial extension
messages:
From: Lydia Park <lydia@clutchhealth.com>
To: Vivek Kulkarni <vivek@redwood.ai>
Cc: David Cho <david.cho@clutchhealth.com>, procure@clutchhealth.com
Date: Sun, 02 May 2027 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: Clutch RFP — ask on trial extension and competitive offset

Hi Vivek,

Thanks again for the demo last week — the team liked Redwood's latency and the batching behavior. Clutch is running a 3‑vendor bake‑off and procurement has asked us to confirm vendor parity for trial resources. Two quick asks: 1) can Redwood extend the evaluation window from 30 to 90 days for the pilot, and 2) are you able to provide a competitive offset (one‑time credits or equivalent) to neutralize existing credits the other vendors have offered?

We attached the RFP scope so you can see expected token volumes (high‑throughput document classification, up to ~150k tokens/day for the pilot). Procurement would like a written statement by COB Wednesday.

Cheers,
Lydia Park
Head of AI Integrations, Clutch Health
(Attachment: Clutch_RFP_Scope.pdf)

From: Vivek Kulkarni <vivek@redwood.ai>
To: Lydia Park <lydia@clutchhealth.com>
Cc: David Cho <david.cho@clutchhealth.com>
Date: Sun, 02 May 2027 11:05:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Clutch RFP — ask on trial extension and competitive offset

Hi Lydia — really appreciate the context and the scope doc.

Short answers: yes on the extension, and we can provide a targeted credit package to match competitive parity for the bake‑off. Before I get a formal authorization out, can you confirm the expected pilot duration and approximate token budget (or equivalent $ value) you need us to match? That will help me size the credit and routing policy (we can recommend a dedicated pool for the run).

I can get a written confirmation to procurement by Wednesday once we lock the numbers.

Best,
Vivek Kulkarni
Sr. Director, Strategic Accounts, Redwood Inference

On Sun, May 2, 2027 at 09:12, Lydia Park <lydia@clutchhealth.com> wrote:
> Hi Vivek,
>
> Thanks again for the demo last week — the team liked Redwood's latency and the batching behavior...

From: Vivek Kulkarni <vivek@redwood.ai>
To: Marissa Cole <marissa@redwood.ai>, Priyom Das <priyom@redwood.ai>
Cc: Rachel Kim <rachel@redwood.ai>
Date: Mon, 03 May 2027 08:30:00 -0700
Subject: Fw: Clutch RFP — ask on trial extension and competitive offset (approval request)

Team — forwarding Clutch's request. Quick summary:
- Pilot: 90 days requested (was 30)
- Estimated peak: ~150k tokens/day, doc classification workload for 8 weeks of active eval
- Ask: trial extension + "competitive offset" (they want parity with credits other vendors are offering)

Proposed sales-side offer to close the bake‑off:
- Provide 200,000 free credit tokens (equivalent to $12k list) + 90‑day extension OR
- Provide an operational offset: dedicated medium pool with 3x burst capacity for the pilot + 100k credit top‑up (if procurement insists on infrastructure parity)

I need an approval to allocate credits from the promotional budget and signoff for a 90‑day extension. If approved, I will confirm the exact token/$ equivalence to Lydia and get procurement the written confirmation.

Relevant deal: CLUTCH‑RFP‑2027‑05 (HubSpot link below). I attached the credit authorization form that ops needs to create the promo.

(Attachment: credits_authorization_req.pdf)

Thanks — Vivek

From: Marissa Cole <marissa@redwood.ai>
To: Vivek Kulkarni <vivek@redwood.ai>, Priyom Das <priyom@redwood.ai>
Cc: Rachel Kim <rachel@redwood.ai>
Date: Mon, 03 May 2027 10:45:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Fw: Clutch RFP — ask on trial extension and competitive offset (approval request)

Vivek — this looks reasonable given the deal profile and CLTV. Approve the 200k token credit + 90‑day extension with two conditions:
1) Clause in written confirmation that credits are one‑time, non‑transferable, and expire at the end of the extension window;
2) We require a short MA (mutual action) plan signed within 30 days of pilot start — include milestones for tech check, model comparisons, and a sync cadence.

Priyom — please pre‑create the promotional code and MA template (I've updated the draft in the attached workbook). Once Vivek confirms to Clutch, send the promo code and MA link and loop in CS for onboarding.

Marissa Cole
VP, Sales Operations
(Attachment: draft_MA_plan.xlsx)

From: Vivek Kulkarni <vivek@redwood.ai>
To: Lydia Park <lydia@clutchhealth.com>, David Cho <david.cho@clutchhealth.com>, procure@clutchhealth.com
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa@redwood.ai>, Priyom Das <priyom@redwood.ai>, Rachel Kim <rachel@redwood.ai>
Date: Tue, 04 May 2027 16:40:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Clutch RFP — confirmation of credit package and next steps

Hi Lydia / David — thanks for the prompt details. Clutch confirms the pilot parameters (90‑day window, expected 120–160k tokens/day). Per internal approval, Redwood will provide:

- 200,000 token credit top‑up (one‑time promotional credit)
- 90‑day trial extension starting on the pilot activation date
- Promo terms: credits are one‑time, non‑transferable, expire at extension end; Redwood will provide a dedicated medium pool for the pilot with routing policies to optimize latency.

Next steps:
1) Lydia — can you confirm pilot start date (we recommend starting the week of May 10) so we can issue promo code and provision the dedicated pool.
2) Priyom/Rachel — please issue promo code and upload the MA template link.
3) Marissa — can CS be on a kickoff call for May 11?

I've copied procurement per their request. Attached is the formal confirmation PDF for procurement countersignature.

Best regards,
Vivek Kulkarni
Sr. Director, Strategic Accounts, Redwood Inference
(Attachment: credits_authorization_req.pdf)

From: Priyom Das <priyom@redwood.ai>
To: Vivek Kulkarni <vivek@redwood.ai>, Marissa Cole <marissa@redwood.ai>
Cc: Rachel Kim <rachel@redwood.ai>
Date: Tue, 04 May 2027 16:55:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Clutch RFP — confirmation of credit package and next steps

Done — promo code CLUTCH‑200K has been generated and assigned to deal CLUTCH‑RFP‑2027‑05. MA template link: https://drive.google.com/drive/folders/1aB2cClutchRFP

I'll coordinate with CS to provision the dedicated pool and confirm the kickoff time.

— Priyom
Product Partnerships, Redwood Inference
